title: When can we expect to see improvements after commencing occupational therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network?
metaTitle: Anticipating Improvements After Starting Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about what to expect once your child begins occupational therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Observe steady, step-by-step progress and continual skill development within a few weeks of tailored, professional therapy.
html: We understand as parents, you are eager to observe your child's progress. While every child is unique and the timeline can depend on the condition's severity, often parents can note minor improvements within just a few weeks of therapy. Our ultimate goal at Pinnacle Blooms Network is steady, consistent progress allowing your child to continually acquire and develop new skills at their own pace.
